_about: Template for the packaged cad-agent.json. launcher.py install copies it to the package root,
fills in packaged/version/data_dir/models_dir/python, and the plugin, dashboard, MCP server and
redline pipeline all read the result (cadagent_config.py). Environment variables still override.
project_roots: folders searched for .dwg files named on redlined sheets; set them per installation.
models: one entry per model name the pipeline asks for; file/mmproj are names under models_dir;
url/mmproj_url are where `launcher.py fetch-models` gets them. Verify the URLs before a release.
